name: video-preview-with-sound
displayName: MP4 & MOV Viewer, Video Player with Sound
description: MP4 viewer, MOV viewer and video player for VS Code that plays MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM and AVI with the sound VS Code mutes. Converts ProRes and other codecs VS Code cannot play, shows .srt and .vtt subtitles and remembers where you stopped.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the video plays, but ffmpeg or afconvert only runs after you click Turn on sound.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Remote and virtual files play without the sound helper.

enumDescriptions: Use ffmpeg if found, else afconvert on macOS
Use macOS afconvert first (built into macOS, cannot open MKV or WebM)
Never run a helper: the video plays without sound
videoPreview.soundHelper.description: Program that turns AAC, AC-3 and other sound VS Code cannot play into FLAC. Nothing is bundled; the extension runs your own copy.

videoPreview.ffmpegPath.description: Full path to ffmpeg. Leave empty to search PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.

videoPreview.decodeSoundAutomatically.description: Start the sound helper as soon as a file opens. Turn off to start it with a click. It never starts by itself in an untrusted workspace.

videoPreview.maxDecodeSizeMB.description: Do not run the sound helper on files bigger than this. Bigger files still play, without sound.

videoPreview.cacheSizeMB.description: Most disk space for decoded sound and remuxed files. The least recently used files go first.

videoPreview.helperTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop the helper if it runs longer than this.

videoPreview.convertUnsupportedVideo.description: Convert videos VS Code cannot decode (Apple ProRes, MPEG-4 Part 2, AVI, WMV, MPEG and others) to H.264 with your own ffmpeg as soon as they open. Turn off to convert with a click. It never starts by itself in an untrusted workspace. The copy is kept in the cache (videoPreview.cacheSizeMB).

videoPreview.subtitles.autoLoad.description: Show the first subtitle file found next to the video (movie.srt, movie.vtt, movie.en.srt ...) as soon as it opens. Off: the tracks are listed under CC but stay hidden until you pick one or press C.

videoPreview.rememberPosition.description: Start each video where you stopped it last time (with its speed), and keep the last volume and mute. Positions of the 200 most recent files are kept on this computer only.

videoPreview.autoplay.description: Start playing as soon as a video opens. If VS Code blocks it, the video waits for Play.

videoPreview.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used Video Preview for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

videoPreview.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in a thin line under the player controls. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Video Preview with Sound
walkthroughs.description: Play videos with sound, step through frames and save a frame as PNG.

steps.title: Open a video
steps.description:
Click any .mp4, .mov, .m4v, .mkv or .webm file in the Explorer. It opens in Video Preview with Sound.
[Find a video](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.mp4%22%5D)

media.altText: An MP4 playing in Video Preview with Sound with the control bar and the metadata panel.

steps.title: Get the sound
steps.description:
VS Code has no AAC decoder. On macOS the built-in afconvert decodes the sound; on Windows and Linux install ffmpeg. The status chip shows which one ran.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22videoPreview%22%5D)

steps.title: Use the keys
steps.description: Space plays, comma and period step one frame, [ and ] change speed, A and B set a loop, S saves the frame as PNG, I shows the metadata.

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
